backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md core multi-window protocol plus Space frozen snapshots

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies; forward replacement profiles come from closed 2026 event-state ledger rows, so any helper remains default-off metadata and live Space slots stay zero.

attention_overlay_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

government_contract_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_depth.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

single_event_defense_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

gate_questions.q1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: scale official Space signals where closed 10d forward evidence is deeper than the accepted exp-001 profile because at least two mature official non-attention events are cash-positive and same-theme-positive.
q2_prior_experiments: exp-20260513-113 accepted cash-positive plus same-theme-positive forward replacement risk at 1.05x.
exp-20260514-001 accepted the same-theme replacement-strength sub-bucket at $500 / 1.05x.
exp-20260513-111 rejected source-diverse strong peer-excess retuning.
exp-20260513-012 accepted raw official event depth, but this tests closed forward outcome depth instead of raw seed count.
gate_questions.q3_single_causal_variable: Only the additional event-depth risk scalar changes; accepted exp-001 stack and all entries/exits/ranking/targets stay fixed.
gate_questions.q4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown damage <= 0.5pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 aggregate trades, real adjusted signals, and target set narrower than exp-001.

hypothesis: On top of accepted exp-20260514-001, official Space signals whose closed 10d forward event-state profile has at least two positive official non-attention events may deserve incremental default-off risk. This tests the playbook's catalyst-family/source/profile replacement-value direction without LLM soft-ranking, ticker expansion, or live Space slots.
known_risks: The Space sleeve remains default-off and historical Space snapshots are frozen research copies.
Forward replacement profiles are closed 2026 outcomes and should not be treated as proof for live routing.
The event-depth sample is narrow; promotion needs conservative sizing and parity tests if accepted.
next_evidence_needed: Do not promote event-depth risk from this frozen replay. Use more closed forward rows or a different catalyst-quality axis.

locked_variables: all prior accepted Space risk helpers

rejection_reason: No tested forward event-depth scalar improved aggregate EV/PnL across the three windows without a window-level EV regression, drawdown/survival violation, or exp-001 target-set overlap violation.
single_causal_variable: extra risk scalar for the narrowed official Space closed-forward event-depth profile bucket with at least two mature positive events
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking remains label-thin; noisy ticker expansion and mature satcom breadth have failed; recent source-diversity peer magnitude retunes are exhausted. This tests forward replacement evidence depth instead.
